attribution.rule: A material may affect a product result only when the evidence source identifies the product or an explicitly labeled component of that product.

conflicts.rule: Do not silently select between disagreeing strong product-specific sources. Record the conflict and withhold an authoritative classification pending review.

evidence.lossless_capture: Preserve raw composition, product description, accepted declaration, exact source identity, capture date and reader/Standard versions. Recalculate from raw captures, never shortened display fields. A bare material summary cannot override a compatible complete product declaration.

composition.incomplete_percentages: Retain known percentages and unknown remainder; do not score the whole product unless its declared composition is complete within tolerance. Impossible totals are evidence errors.
composition.unquantified_materials: Record presence and classification only. Do not invent percentages or imply equal shares.
composition.made_with: A material named after 'made with' is present; quantity remains unknown unless explicitly stated.
composition.contains: A named material is present; quantity remains unknown unless explicitly stated.
composition.unweighted_material_classes: Classify the named materials; do not derive a quantitative share.
percentage_parsing: Pair each percentage with the nearest attributable material in a composition clause.
Reject unrelated sale, water-saving, care, or promotional percentages.
A listed set of percentages is complete only when it totals 100 within tolerance.

components.unknown_component_weight: Never invent equal or physical component weights. Component shares remain separate; identical class-share vectors produce an invariant product share.

equal_component_fallback.when: Every explicitly listed component has a complete 100% composition, and no component weight is published.
equal_component_fallback.method: Do not infer physical component weights. Show component-level declarations; withhold whole-product share unless published weights exist or all component class-share vectors are identical.
equal_component_fallback.required_explanation: Separate component composition is available; overall component weights are not published.

disclosure.definition: Successfully inspected product with no usable published composition. Partial declarations and technical failures are separate states.
disclosure.classification_implication: None; undisclosed is not synthetic, non-plant, or a negative material finding.
disclosure.score_treatment: No numerical composition contribution; affects evidence coverage only.

catalogue.target: Census of the entire eligible catalogue.
catalogue.locale_policy: Do not combine markets or locales in one catalogue. Record market, locale, host, and currency.
incremental_policy: re-score cached evidence after Standard changes

technical_failures.score_policy: Exclude failed products from composition arithmetic. Retain failure counts, retry them, and scope any displayed result to assessed products. Never label partial evidence as a verified full-catalogue score.

scoring.textile_formula: mean(declared_plant_fibre_percent for eligible products with complete quantified composition)
scoring.undisclosed_treatment: Excluded from the composition-score denominator; counted in composition coverage and missing-evidence reporting. No material finding is inferred.
scoring.nontextile_treatment: Non-textile products and accessories are explicitly classified, retained for catalogue reconciliation, and excluded from the textile eligible denominator, textile score, missing-composition blockers, and textile price coverage.

score_status.census: verified only when every eligible product has a complete quantified composition and no technical failures
score_status.readable_subset: partial_scan: score describes fully quantified assessed products only, with at least 20 assessed products; never the unknown catalogue remainder
score_status.technical_gap: partial_scan; do not relabel failures as undisclosed

scoring.beauty_formula: Share of fully assessed products whose complete ingredient declaration meets the INCI purity rule; not a concentration or weight percentage. Use the shared score bands; unresolved ingredient declarations block an authoritative beauty catalogue score.

textile_score_labels.1: Below 40% plant fibre in assessed products
textile_score_labels.2: At least 40% plant fibre in assessed products
textile_score_labels.3: At least 70% plant fibre in assessed products
textile_score_labels.4: At least 90% plant fibre in assessed products

scoring.aggregation_unit: One confirmed product/attributable composition variant, equally weighted by product, not by assumed sales or physical garment mass. Preserve market and source-store identity.
scoring.missing_evidence_policy: Unknown, undisclosed, unread, conflicting and unquantified compositions reduce coverage only. They cannot be scored as 0% plant, synthetic, animal or semi-synthetic.
scoring.scope_policy: A full-catalogue composition score requires all eligible compositions. Otherwise the number describes assessed products only; count, coverage, capture date and missing count must accompany it. A non-random subset is never a statistical estimate of unassessed products.
scoring.catalogue_bounds: Show minimum and maximum possible whole-catalogue plant share separately, assigning each unknown product 0% and 100% respectively. Bounds are not scores or confidence intervals.

sampling.composition_interval: For an explicitly random sample whose eligible selected products all have complete compositions, use a conservative 95% bounded-mean interval (Hoeffding). Missing selected products withhold catalogue inference. Opportunistic assessed subsets have no population-confidence claim.

price_fields.variant_range: Do not present a minimum variant price as the price of every variant.

scanner_owned.overwrite_policy: Scanner results overwrite only fields listed as scanner-owned. A manual edit to these fields is not durable; source evidence and Standard version remain attached.

editorial_owned.overwrite_policy: Never overwrite editorial-owned values automatically. Scanner enrichment may offer a sourced suggestion for review.

scanner_suggested.overwrite_policy: Store with source URL, evidence text, capture time, and confidence; require editorial approval before promoting to editorial-owned fields.

manual_immutable.overwrite_policy: Never infer from names, photographs, or geography. Update only from explicit public evidence or verified editorial review; never overwrite automatically.

changes: Classify accessories separately from eligible textile products and non-textile products using product identity evidence.
Retain accessories and non-textile products in catalogue reconciliation while excluding them from textile report rows, score denominators, missing-composition blockers, and textile price coverage.
Expose separate accessory and non-textile exclusion counts so out-of-scope products are identified without entering the textile report.
Removed the swimwear-specific scoring exception. Swimwear now uses the same textile composition plant-share scoring as clothing and bedding.
Legacy swimwear result fields remain compatibility-clearing fields only and no longer calculate or alter a score.
Separate measured composition quality from evidence coverage; missing evidence no longer receives a zero composition value.
Aggregate full declared plant percentages across assessed products, including blends.
Scope partial scores to assessed products; retain catalogue bounds and prohibit inference from non-random subsets.
Preserve raw source inputs and prefer compatible complete declarations over shortened material summaries.
Remove inferred equal component weights from numerical composition scoring.
Partial material evidence never earns complete pure-plant product credit. Unknown remainder stays explicit.
Impossible totals in a single composition are evidence errors and block automatic score publication. Separate complete named components are not summed as one garment; estimates remain identified.
Route every SKU independently and keep distinct department and swimwear results. Unknown departments return an unresolved result.
Automatic score publication requires trusted complete catalogue enumeration, reconciled product identities and no unresolved evidence errors.
Capture stated offers in the declared default currency, then a real USD offer; never invent a currency or exchange rate.
Beauty catalogue scores use the shared evidence-rate bands; 5/5 requires every assessed product to pass and no unresolved declarations. Score thresholds use unrounded rates.
Added a hard swimwear scoring exception based on quantified natural-fibre share rather than the ordinary pure-plant product pass/fail rule.
Required complete quantified composition for a swimwear SKU score; unknown remainders remain unscored rather than guessed.
Restricted swimwear brand scores to eligible swim garments so cover-ups, accessories and unrelated clothing cannot inflate the category result.
Kept recycled synthetics as a separately reported attribute rather than counting them as natural fibre.
Established one machine-readable Throne Standard and shared material taxonomy.
Defined textile score as verified plant evidence across the eligible census catalogue; undisclosed products receive no evidence credit but remain a distinct state.
Kept the 20-product lower guard only for subset-based statistical analysis and set the disclosure transparency threshold to 25%.
Defined 95% confidence, +/-5 percentage-point, p=0.5 sampling with finite population correction.
Made unquantified description materials presence-only and documented the equal-component fallback.
Defined score labels as verified-evidence descriptions rather than material-quality claims.
Allowed explicit partial and component-level compositions to score the material evidence actually stated, preserving unknown remainder and flagging totals above 100%.
Initial machine-readable Throne Standard release.

sync_contract.empty_value_policy: Blank HTT values do not erase richer IdealWrld values.
sync_contract.destination_owned_policy: IdealWrld editorial_owned and manual_immutable fields are never overwritten by the Standard sync.
